boundary: Supplemental zero-input controlled sequence injection. It proves the binder boundary for 13 selected cases, exact resource/task identity for 10 cases, and 25 visible task-component to submitted-OAM bindings across those 10 cases; it does not prove natural entry, renderer write-instruction ownership, all frames, blend/audio behavior, or physical GBA output.

rss_sampling.boundary: Four sub-second runs were under-sampled at roughly 0.17 MiB. Per-case samples are preserved but no batch peak, average, or upper bound is claimed.
